shell.command: which claude >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo HEARTBEAT_OK || echo HEARTBEAT_FAIL:claude_not_found

jobs.name: Clean up expired invites and bind tokens

shell.command: find workspaces/invites -type f -name '*.json' -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null; find workspaces/bind-tokens -type f -name '*.json' -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null; echo CLEANUP_OK
